units.explanation: The bounded native model download consumes the streamed response; not every workspace futures consumer.
Native model downloads/probes and always-compiled private handoff/setup origin validation use reqwest::Url. Setup parsing does not send an outbound request; it adds no new crate owner.
Native model IPC, nested fields and auth/handoff/setup protocols share serde derives; optional listeners serialize the corresponding bridge profiles.

Strict handoff/setup envelope JSON, model manifests and local auth candidate serialization share serde_json. The setup catalog remains an opaque bounded value here; complete catalog validation belongs to the frontend.
Handoff proofs, model integrity and setup catalog/envelope/challenge digests share SHA-256. These production owner edges remain production context when host tests exercise them.

Proof decoding, model checksum encoding, optional inference identity decoding and random transport IDs use the same hex edge; the setup listener adds an ID encoding call only when local-app-handoff is enabled.

Feature-owned Tauri IPC commands, main-window checks, managed auth/handoff/setup state, asset resolution, native runtime and nested errors retain the same owner. Unrelated core command behavior is not audited.
Native model download/DNS/synchronization, optional inference spawn_blocking and feature-gated auth/handoff/setup listener operations retain the Tokio owner.
The model selection resource probe reads available RAM and disk via this direct owner.
Optional host inference compile coverage only; not enabled by either all-WebGPU APK profile.

The shared Result returned by the native URL/IPC bridge contains this derived error schema; all nested external error types are retained. The unchanged native workspace dependency accepts version 2; the checksum-verified cached 2.0.18 archive retains MIT OR Apache-2.0 and pins thiserror-impl exactly to 2.0.18. Source-owned native bundled/cache compatibility gate keeps the local client from selecting an old live-production bundle. No legacy OTA downloader or unrelated backend root is added.
